Resolvent Restrictions on a Cubic Normalization Defect

statement: For a complex generic-degree-three Keller map, every target prime divisor has a retained unramified sheet and hence only the U1, U2, or B deleted-sheet type; a deleted three-cycle is impossible, and the generic monodromy is S3.
title: Cubic Keller Maps Have Only the U1, U2, and B Divisorial Types
